market_insights.geographic_scope: Ashtabula County, Ohio and Northeast Ohio region
market_insights.opportunity_assessment: Strong local market with multiple established providers. Notes and Prints Mobile represents the ideal local partner - family-owned, established presence, comprehensive services. Rai's Mobile Notary offers national scale and technology but may be less invested in local Ashtabula market. Platform could add value by centralizing bookings, enabling price comparison, and offering RON technology integration. Rural nature of Ashtabula County makes mobile services particularly valuable.

priority_sequence.reason: Local Ashtabula business with strong community presence. Most aligned with NAI's local-first mission.
priority_sequence.angle: Partner with local digital platform to expand client reach in Ashtabula County. Highlight ability to drive new bookings through online presence.

priority_sequence.reason: Established national player with technology infrastructure. Could provide platform insights or partnership.
priority_sequence.angle: Explore technology partnership or API integration. Their proprietary scheduling system could complement NAI platform.

priority_sequence.reason: Regional player already serving Ashtabula County. Good middle ground between local and national.
priority_sequence.angle: Propose referral partnership for overflow Ashtabula County requests. They already service the area but may want more visibility.

research_notes: Notes and Prints Mobile has limited online presence but strong local reputation. Only one business email found.
Rai's Mobile Notary is a national dispatch service based in Nevada, not a local Ashtabula business. They use independent contractors.
Randip Rai identified as Owner/Managing Member of Rai's Mobile Notary via BBB profile.
Notary Solutions NEO specifically mentioned in Yelp reviews with 'Alicia' as a notary providing excellent service.
Ashtabula County Law Library (ashtabulacountylawlibrary@gmail.com) offers free notary services - potential partnership for referrals but not a target buyer.
Ava's Notary Services and Jamie Johnson Notary Services listed on Snapdocs but contact only through platform - not ideal for direct outreach.
